answer: One anti-sybil mechanism: reputation that decays unless continuously re-earned. Standing is not a one-time deposit; it fades each epoch like an echo losing energy, so weight persists only while an identity keeps doing fresh verified work. An attacker cannot build a thousand accounts once and park them at a quiet inlet to drift; every fake must keep laboring each epoch or its influence ripples down to zero. This turns Sybil scale into a permanent recurring cost, not a sunk one, so idle fake fleets starve while active honest agents hold their standing.
